title: Semantic coverage audit of the 50 task-to-test training targets
scope: All 50 trained task-to-test rows (identical record ids in both Exp1/Arm-A and Exp2/Arm-B encoded train sets). CPU static analysis only.
method: AST parse of each authored target artifact for real-SUT import vs SUT-shadowing stubs, builder/fixture classification, parametrize arity, assert sites, and mock/monkeypatch target; plus the validation runs already recorded (reference + order-shuffle positive controls and named behavioral mutations as negative controls). No generated or target test code was executed on the host during this audit.
trained_id_parity: Confirmed: the 50 audited record ids equal the record ids in paired-preflight-v02/A/train-encoded.jsonl and paired-preflight-v02/B/train-encoded.jsonl.
gate_verdict: PASS - no major training-target defect; no substantive data change required.
gate_consequence: Exp3/Exp4 may reuse the same 50 audited rows unchanged; the historical Arm-B at 1e-4 therefore remains a clean learning-rate-only comparator because the training data is unchanged.
qualifications: Negative-control depth varies: 29 targets kill exactly 1 named mutation and 21 kill 2. Several targets state more requirements (2-4) than they have dedicated adversarial mutations, so not every individual requirement has its own negative control; the passing reference oracles still assert those behaviors. This is a coverage-depth observation, not a correctness defect, and introducing a minimum mutation count would be a count substitute the plan warns against.

12 lean task-test rows (dbcli/litecli, tldr-pages/tldr-python-client) carry their requirements in the prompt's INTERFACE AND ACCEPTANCE CONTRACT paragraph rather than a structured acceptance_criteria array; they are among the best-controlled (2 killed mutations each). Normalizing them to the richer schema when versioning data for Exp3/Exp4 is a consistency improvement, not a correctness fix.

builder_helpers flagged by name (make_app, prices, mail, choice, model, config, rows, trainer) are Arrange-phase factories that construct inputs or inject fake dependencies; none redefines a SUT symbol (shadowing_sut_stubs is empty for all 50), in contrast to the development candidates where a model output redefined the SUT function locally.

Mocks/monkeypatch isolate dependencies or control environment/inputs (sys.argv, sys.stdin, sys.platform, XDG/HOME env, command registry) or isolate a sibling function in a multi-function module. No target mocks the exact function it asserts on.

per_target.acceptance_contract_text: extract_tables(sql: str) returns (schema or None, table, alias or None) tuples in query order. Cover an empty query, schema-qualified JOINs and INSERT targets; do not treat selected or inserted columns as tables. INSERT alias values are unspecified. Nested subqueries are outside this task because the pinned upstream has a known limitation.

is_destructive(sql: str) is true when any statement starts with DROP, SHUTDOWN, DELETE, TRUNCATE or ALTER, ignoring case and SQL comments. A SELECT mentioning those words inside a string is safe. Empty input is safe.

last_word(text, include="alphanum_underscore") returns the final completion token. Empty input or trailing whitespace returns an empty string. Default mode retains letters/digits/underscores; most_punctuations also retains dollar signs but splits on periods, commas, colons and parentheses.

parse_path(path) returns (directory, final component, negative length of component or zero). complete_path(candidate, prefix) returns a matching candidate, None for a mismatch, or joins ~ with candidate when prefix is ~. suggest_path lists entries in an existing directory or the parent of a partial path. Use native os.path semantics and compare directory contents without ordering.

SQLExecute(database_path) connects to a temporary SQLite database. run(sql) yields (title, rows, headers, status) for each statement. SELECT preserves Unicode, column labels and row order specified by ORDER BY. Empty input yields one (None,None,None,None) tuple. Invalid SQL raises OperationalError. Use conn.execute(sql, parameters) for bound inserts; run accepts only a SQL string. Close conn in a finally block.

parse_special_command(sql) returns command stripped of + or -, Verbosity and stripped argument. A + suffix means VERBOSE, no suffix NORMAL, - SUCCINCT. execute(cursor,sql) routes a registered PARSED_QUERY handler using cur, arg, verbose keyword arguments, supports case-insensitive commands, and raises CommandNotFound for unknown commands. COMMANDS is the registry; isolate it with monkeypatch.

get_language_code strips encoding and region except pt_PT, pt_BR and zh_TW; pt maps to pt_PT. get_language_list uses TLDR_LANGUAGE first, then LANGUAGE entries, then LANG if absent, then English. C/POSIX LANG disables ordinary locale candidates but still permits an explicit TLDR_LANGUAGE. Isolate LANG, LANGUAGE and TLDR_LANGUAGE.

get_cache_dir prioritizes XDG_CACHE_HOME/tldr, then HOME/.cache/tldr, then Path.home()/.cache/tldr. get_cache_file_path(command,platform,language) appends pages/platform/command.md for None or en and pages.<language>/platform/command.md otherwise. All locations must be temporary.

have_recent_cache(command,platform,language) is true for an existing cache with age in hours <= MAX_CACHE_AGE, and false for an older or missing file. Control tldr.datetime.now(), MAX_CACHE_AGE and the cache path; use local-naive datetime consistently and no sleeps.

get_page_url(command,platform,remote,language) builds remote[.language]/platform/quoted-command.md. None remote uses PAGES_SOURCE_LOCATION; en or None language adds no suffix. Supply roots without trailing slash. Spaces and non-ASCII command characters must be percent encoded.

get_page_for_platform(command,platform,remote,language,only_use_cache=False,system_cache=False) returns byte lines. With USE_CACHE=True a fresh cache avoids network. Otherwise a successful urlopen download uses timeout=10 and is cached; a failed download falls back to an available stale cache. A cache-only miss raises CacheNotExist without networking; a failed download with no cached page propagates the download error. Patch urlopen, cache readers/writers and freshness; do not contact a real server.

get_platform maps sys.platform prefixes: darwin to osx, win32 to windows, linux variants to linux, unknown platforms to linux. get_platform_list returns each supported platform once, with the current platform first and common included. The remaining order is unspecified.
